description: This Java class, XYDataReader, reads a data file containing points, processes each line to create Point3D objects, and accumulates them into XYData. It includes methods to read and parse the file, handle exceptions, and log the data range for X and Y values.

classes.name: XYDataReader
classes.description: Provides functionality to read XY data points from a file and return an XYData object containing the points.

methods.name: readFile
methods.description: Public static method that checks if the specified file exists and attempts to read and parse its contents into XYData.

methods.name: doReadFile
methods.description: Private static method that performs the actual file reading, line parsing, point creation, and data collection, logging the range of X and Y values.
